evidence.detail: Exact item-config parsing stores rs/a/b/c as the item definition's model override aggregate and routes the keys opacity, recolor/recolors, retexture/retextures and reshade into this object.
The aggregate's a(Model) method applies its configured recolor, reshade, retexture and opacity operations across the recovered R30 Model before the model is returned/rendered.
Item-definition cloning deep-copies this aggregate with the rs/a/b/c copy constructor, confirming it is definition-owned model material/face override state rather than transient renderer state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 aggregate name for item-definition model material overrides.

evidence.detail: Exact item-config cases 'recolor' and 'recolors' construct rs/a/b/a from the decoded int[][][] value and attach it to ModelMaterialOverrides.
The class indexes Model face-color values, maps configured source colors to one or more destination colors and replaces matching face colors during per-face application.
It extends the shared rs/a/b/b face-override base and implements whole-model plus per-face application only.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 recolor override from parser-key and Model face-color mutation evidence.

evidence.detail: Exact item-config cases 'retexture' and 'retextures' obtain/create rs/a/b/e and feed decoded source/destination texture mappings into it.

For matching Model faces the class marks the face as transformed, replaces the mapped face value, allocates/updates texture-triangle metadata and copies the face vertex indices into the texture coordinate arrays.
It extends the shared rs/a/b/b face-override base and exposes the configured source-value set used by item/model consumers.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 retexture override from parser-key and texture-triangle mutation evidence.

evidence.detail: The class is the abstract base for the exact recolor, retexture and reshade override implementations and defines whole-Model and per-face application methods.
Its concrete helper iterates Model face count and dispatches the subclass per-face transformation for every face.
No unrelated behavior or state exists; all exact subclasses are item-definition-driven Model face/material transforms.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 abstract base for per-face Model overrides.

evidence.detail: Exact item-config key 'reshade' constructs rs/a/b/d from the configured integer and attaches it to ModelMaterialOverrides.
Its per-face method replaces the Model face color/shade integer with the configured value unless that face has already been claimed by the retexture transform.
It extends the shared rs/a/b/b face-override base and owns only the single configured reshade value.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 reshade override from the parser key and direct per-face shade/color replacement.
